project.name: Todo App
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 个人待办工具，清新鼠尾草绿主色，暖灰中性色，圆角柔和，留白充裕，呼吸感工具型设计
project.designRead: personal productivity / casual users / calm fresh utility / medium-low density / avoid corporate blue

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: sage green for primary actions, checkmarks, active states
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single primary sage green hue only; no secondary/accent brand hue

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: rounded-soft: sm 6px, md 10px, lg 14px, full pill
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter + Noto Sans SC sans-serif stack; clean and legible
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: 4px base, generous padding for breathing room
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: clean cards with subtle border, no heavy shadows on static elements
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: border-first for static cards, shadow only for floating layers (modal, drawer)
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: minimal line icons, checkmarks as primary visual motif

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: top status bar + app title + bottom tab bar with 3 tabs (tasks, add, categories)
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: single sage green primary hue; identities via neutral tints
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Inter + Noto Sans SC, h1 24px bold, h2 20px semi, body 14px regular
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: border-first static, shadow only for floating layers
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: rounded-full pill button, sage green bg, white text, gentle hover lift
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: left-aligned content, centered modals, consistent 16-20px horizontal padding

privateRegions: page body: greeting, date, filter tabs, task list, FAB
page body: add task form with title, description, category, priority, date
page body: category list, add new category

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Sage green primary, warm gray neutral, soft rounded corners, border-first depth, Inter+Noto Sans SC typography, generous spacing

pages.title: 任务首页
pages.businessScenario: daily task list with greeting, date display, filter tabs, task items with checkboxes
pages.visualNorthStar: a calm, breathable task interface where the sage green checkmark is the visual anchor
pages.compositionPattern: mobile single-column list with sticky header

pages.title: 添加任务
pages.businessScenario: add new task form with title input, optional description, category picker, priority selector, due date
pages.visualNorthStar: a focused, distraction-free form where the input field is the hero element
pages.compositionPattern: mobile centered form with floating save button

pages.title: 分类管理
pages.businessScenario: manage task categories with colored labels, task counts, edit/delete actions
pages.visualNorthStar: a clean card grid where each category is a distinct colored tag with task count
